prompts: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: six authored consecutive idle animation keyframes for Runelord Nightfang Ranger character-select screen. Image 1 is EXACT approved character identity and rendering reference. Produce one clean 3-column by 2-row sprite sheet, six equal cells, reading left to right then next row, preferably 3072x3072 overall. Each cell contains SAME full-body Ranger at identical scale and identical camera with fixed feet positions, generous transparent margins around antler tips, bow tips, cape and feet. Transparent background, zero scenery, shadows, labels, lettering, dividers or glow backdrop. Remove all painted halo from reference. Preserve precisely the adult pale elf face, long platinum-blond hair, pointed ears, dark green angular hood, asymmetrical brown branching antler circlet and emerald forehead diamond, silver segmented leaf-shaped shoulder armor, emerald gems, leaf cloak, dark brown leather belts and black gloves, lower greaves and pointed metal boots, dangling pale fangs at waist, quiver of feathered arrows, enormous asymmetric silver-edged brown bow with green diamond runes on VIEWER RIGHT held in same hand, arrow pointing down held in VIEWER LEFT. Serious detailed clean cel shading, no redesign, no added ornaments. Each cell should be a subtly DIFFERENT genuine drawn upper-body idle pose, not a translated copy. Six successive phases of a half breath: 1 relaxed neutral, 2 lower chest beginning inhale, 3 chest/shoulder lifted slightly and hood/head subtly tilting about one degree with grip following, 4 inhaled chest slightly expanded and cloak tips gently lagging, 5 deep calm breath highest chest, 6 peak inhale with head tiny alert turn and cloak settling. Endpoints nearly same stance; feet/legs absolutely fixed. Very small dignified natural movement, relaxed arm joints with bow hand maintaining grip, no attack, no bow draw, no walking. This sequence will play forward and backward as a loop, so all transitions must be small. All six cells have exact same character equipment and proportions, same antler branches, six bow runes, no duplicate limbs or changed weapons. Preserve alpha around and inside bowstring. Frame poses each fill about 85% cell height. Crisp full resolution.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit image 2 six-frame Nightfang Ranger idle sprite sheet using image 1 as exact identity reference. Correct PACKING only: retain all six poses, but shrink all six characters uniformly by 18% within their existing equal 3-column 2-row cells so each bow tip, cloak and boot has at least 30 transparent pixels clearance from every cell boundary. No part crosses into neighboring cell; no clipping at any external edge. 3 columns x 2 rows, exactly six evenly spaced whole characters. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Keep same foot contact level in each cell, same size and same outfit proportions. Preserve all subtle sequential chest/head/cloth idle pose changes. Bow rune topology must be three upper green diamond runes and three lower green diamond runes in EVERY pose as in image 1. Preserve the narrow adult elf face, antler circlet, platinum hair, deep green hood/cloak, silver leaf armor, fangs at waist, arrow held downward, quiver. Do not add labels, framing, background, outlines or shadows. Retain crisp serious high-detail cel-shaded rendering. Target 3072x3072 sheet with 1024x1536 cells.
notes: First generated sheet rejected for tight source cell bounds. Second requested uniform shrink and three upper/three lower bow diamond runes. Technical exporter crops cells and translates only, no new character painting.
